title: ETH Bot
tagline: A universal bot that allows users to manage and query omnichain activities powered with AI capabilities.
description:
ETH Bot is an intent-based chatbot designed to interact with EVM-compatible blockchains using natural language, and is a mobile-first dApp that makes it easy to access.

Three features has been implemented in the bot during this hackathon. The first feature is the ability to claim some test ETH on the Sepolia testnet. The second feature is to create a sign protocol's schema that you can use for attestation. The last one is the ability to send a tip to a Twitter account.
how_its_made:
We've integrated with web3auth's MPC kit and wallet pre-generation features for auth and transfer assets to any Twitter account without requiring them to undergo the wallet creation process.

XMTP's message kit to send test ETHs to claimers and used to be a unified place to create sign protocol's schema.
